name: ICWSM-DataHub
description: A curated meta-dataset of ICWSM Dataset Track papers (2020-2026): extracted metadata, FAIR indicators and an empirical 2026 accessibility audit of every released dataset.
citeAs: Please cite the ICWSM-DataHub paper (see CITATION.cff).

recordSet.name: papers
recordSet.description: One record per ICWSM Dataset Track paper.

field.name: paper_id
field.description: Stable identifier: <year>_<slug of PDF name>_<hash>.

field.name: year
field.description: ICWSM proceedings year (from the folder the PDF came from).

field.name: pdf_filename
field.description: Original PDF file name.

field.name: title
field.description: Full paper title exactly as printed.

field.name: authors
field.description: All author names in printed order.

field.name: n_authors
field.description: Number of authors.

field.name: author_countries
field.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (uppercase) for countries of all author affiliations, deduplicated, e.g. ['US','IN']. [] if affiliations are not printed.

field.name: author_regions
field.description: World-region(s) of author affiliations (World Bank-style regions).

field.name: author_global_south
field.description: True if any author affiliation is in the Global South (Brandt-line-style approximation, see normalize.py).

field.name: is_industry_collaboration
field.description: True if at least one author lists a company or industry research lab affiliation.

field.name: contribution_type
field.description: Main type of resource the paper contributes. Values: New dataset / Extension or new version of an existing dataset / Benchmark or evaluation suite / Tool or infrastructure released with data / Ongoing archive or data collection effort / Other

field.name: num_datasets_released
field.description: Number of distinct datasets the paper releases. Usually 1. -1 if unclear.

field.name: page_count
field.description: Number of PDF pages.

field.name: checklist_detected
field.description: True if the AAAI/ICWSM paper checklist text is found by regex.

field.name: dataset_name
field.description: Name or acronym the authors give the released dataset. '' if unnamed.

field.name: platforms
field.description: Every platform whose content is in the RELEASED dataset (not platforms only discussed). Values: Twitter/X / Reddit / YouTube / TikTok / Instagram / Facebook / Threads / Telegram / WhatsApp / Discord / Bluesky / Mastodon/Fediverse / 4chan/8kun/Imageboards / Alt-Tech (Gab/Parler/Truth Social/Rumble/BitChute) / LinkedIn / Twitch / Q&A and Forums (Quora/Stack Exchange/other forums) / Chinese platforms (Weibo/Douyin/Bilibili/WeChat) / Regional platforms (VK/ShareChat/Koo/Line/KakaoTalk) / Web/News/Blogs / Wikipedia/Wikidata / Search engines/Google Trends / AI chatbots and LLM output (ChatGPT logs, AI-generated content) / Other

field.name: platform_families
field.description: Platforms grouped into 10 families used in figures and the explorer.

field.name: n_platforms
field.description: Number of distinct platforms.

field.name: platform_names_verbatim
field.description: Platform names exactly as written in the paper, e.g. ['Twitter','X (formerly Twitter)'].

field.name: collection_methods
field.description: All methods used to gather the data. Values: Official platform API / Researcher access program (TikTok Research API, Meta Content Library, DSA Art. 40) / Third-party archive or service (Pushshift, CrowdTangle, Internet Archive, MediaCloud) / Web scraping or browser automation / Data donation (participants export their own data) / Survey or crowdsourced contribution / Rehydration or extension of an existing dataset / Synthetic, LLM-generated or simulated data / Not specified

field.name: collection_tools
field.description: Named APIs, libraries, services or tools used for collection, verbatim, e.g. ['Twitter Academic API v2','snscrape','CrowdTangle','yt-dlp']. [] if none named.

field.name: closed_access_dependencies
field.description: Data-access routes used for collection that have since closed (e.g. Twitter/X Academic API, Pushshift, CrowdTangle).

field.name: depends_on_closed_access
field.description: True if collection relied on at least one closed access route.

field.name: temporal_coverage_start
field.description: Earliest date of content in the dataset as YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY. '' if not stated.

field.name: temporal_coverage_end
field.description: Latest date of content in the dataset as YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY. '' if not stated.

field.name: coverage_end_year
field.description: Year of the last content in the dataset.

field.name: coverage_days
field.description: Days between first and last content (null if either date missing).

field.name: primary_record_unit
field.description: The main unit counted in the dataset size. Values: Posts or tweets / Comments or replies / Users or accounts / Videos / Images or memes / News articles or web pages / Conversations or threads / Chat messages / Channels, groups or communities / Audio or podcast episodes / Survey responses or participants / Other

field.name: total_records
field.description: Total count of the primary unit as an integer (14.2 million -> 14200000). -1 if not stated.

field.name: log10_records
field.description: log10 of total_records.

field.name: num_accounts_or_users
field.description: Number of distinct accounts, users or channels covered. -1 if not stated.

field.name: scale_description_verbatim
field.description: The authors' own phrase describing dataset size, e.g. '14.2M tweets from 450K users'.

field.name: modalities
field.description: Data modalities present in the RELEASED files. Values: Text / Image / Video / Audio / Network or graph / Tabular user or post metadata / Time series or temporal logs / Geospatial or mobility

field.name: is_multimodal
field.description: True if more than one content modality (text, image, video, audio) is released.

field.name: languages_iso
field.description: ISO 639-1 codes (or ISO 639-3 when no 639-1 exists) of languages in the data, lowercase. Use ['mul'] only when the paper says multilingual without listing languages. [] if not stated.

field.name: num_languages
field.description: Number of languages, if stated or countable. -1 if unknown.

field.name: is_multilingual
field.description: True if more than one language.

field.name: includes_code_mixing
field.description: True only if the paper explicitly mentions code-mixed or code-switched text.

field.name: data_geography
field.description: ISO alpha-2 codes of the countries the data is ABOUT or collected FROM (not author countries). ['GLOBAL'] if worldwide without a focus. [] if not stated.

field.name: data_regions
field.description: World-region(s) the data is about.

field.name: data_global_south
field.description: True if the data is about at least one Global South country.

field.name: event_category
field.description: Type of real-world event the dataset centres on, if any. Values: Elections / Pandemic or public health crisis / Armed conflict or war / Protest or social movement / Natural disaster or climate event / Economic or financial event / Sports or entertainment event / Platform policy or ownership change / No specific event

field.name: event_name
field.description: Specific event, e.g. '2022 Brazilian general election'. '' if none.

field.name: involves_vulnerable_groups
field.description: True if the data centres on minors, patients, refugees, LGBTQ+ people, or other groups the paper itself flags as vulnerable.

field.name: research_domains
field.description: CSS research areas the dataset serves (1-3 values). Values: Misinformation and fact-checking / Hate speech, toxicity and harassment / Political communication and elections / Polarization and ideology / Public health and COVID-19 / Mental health and wellbeing / Bots, coordinated inauthentic behavior and propaganda / Extremism and radicalization / Crisis, disaster and conflict informatics / Social movements and activism / News and journalism / Content moderation and platform governance / Gender, race and identity / Online communities and collective behavior / Influencers, marketing and the platform economy / Science communication and education / Privacy and surveillance / AI-generated content and LLM use / Other

field.name: supported_tasks
field.description: Downstream tasks the authors propose or demonstrate. Values: Topic or content classification / Stance detection / Sentiment or emotion analysis / Hate or toxicity detection / Misinformation or claim detection / Bot or coordinated account detection / Network or information diffusion analysis / Virality or popularity prediction / Recommendation or ranking / Retrieval or question answering / Summarization or text generation / Entity or information extraction / Multimodal understanding (image/video/audio) / User profiling or demographic inference / Causal or intervention analysis / Descriptive or exploratory social analysis / Other

field.name: tasks_verbatim
field.description: Task names exactly as the authors phrase them.

field.name: annotation_paradigms
field.description: How labels or enrichments were produced. Use 'Unlabeled raw corpus' if no labels are released. Values: Unlabeled raw corpus / Expert, author or trained student annotation / Crowdworkers (MTurk, Prolific, etc.) / Distant or weak supervision (hashtags, domain lists, heuristics) / Automated classifier or lexicon (BERT, Perspective API, LIWC) / LLM or generative AI labels / Hybrid human and LLM-in-the-loop / Platform-native signals (Community Notes, moderation logs, votes)

field.name: uses_llm_annotation
field.description: True if labels come from an LLM or a hybrid human+LLM pipeline.

field.name: uses_crowd
field.description: True if crowdworkers annotated.

field.name: uses_expert
field.description: True if experts, authors or trained students annotated.

field.name: llms_used
field.description: Specific LLMs used for labeling or generating data, e.g. ['GPT-4o','Llama-3-70B']. [] if none.

field.name: num_annotated_records
field.description: Number of manually or automatically labeled items. -1 if none or not stated.

field.name: num_annotators
field.description: Number of human annotators per item or in total, as stated. -1 if not stated.

field.name: iaa_reported
field.description: True if any inter-annotator agreement value is reported.

field.name: iaa_metrics
field.description: Agreement metrics reported. [] if none. Values: Cohen's kappa / Fleiss' kappa / Krippendorff's alpha / Percent agreement / Correlation or ICC / F1 or accuracy against gold standard / Other metric

field.name: iaa_primary_value
field.description: The main (or average) agreement value reported, as a number between -1 and 1 (convert percentages to 0-1). -1.0 if none.

field.name: iaa_summary_verbatim
field.description: Verbatim sentence or phrase reporting agreement. '' if none.

field.name: baseline_families
field.description: Families of models or analyses the authors run ON THIS DATASET in the paper. Values: No experiments / Descriptive statistics only / Statistical models (regression, time series) / Classical ML (SVM, logistic regression, random forest) / Fine-tuned transformer encoders (BERT family) / LLM prompting (zero- or few-shot) / Graph or network models / Vision, audio or multimodal models

field.name: includes_baselines
field.description: True if any model or analysis beyond descriptive statistics is run.

field.name: release_status
field.description: Whether the data was actually released when the paper was published. Values: Released at publication / Partially released / Promised or forthcoming / Available on request only / Not released / Unclear

field.name: hosting_repositories
field.description: Where the dataset files are hosted. Values: Zenodo / Dataverse (Harvard or other instance) / Figshare / Open Science Framework (OSF) / Hugging Face Hub / GitHub or GitLab / Kaggle / Domain archive (ICPSR, GESIS, Dryad, Mendeley Data) / Personal or lab website, Google Drive, Dropbox / Available on request only / Other / Not stated

field.name: primary_host
field.description: First listed hosting venue, shortened.

field.name: dataset_urls
field.description: Every URL pointing to the dataset, its landing page or project page. Repair URLs split across lines or hyphenated by the PDF. Do NOT include URLs of other datasets cited in related work.

field.name: persistent_doi
field.description: Dataset DOI as a bare string, e.g. '10.5281/zenodo.1234567'. Not the paper's own DOI. '' if none.

field.name: has_doi
field.description: True if a dataset DOI (not the paper DOI) is reported.

field.name: code_repository_url
field.description: URL of code for collection, hydration or baselines. '' if none.

field.name: distribution_form
field.description: What content is shared: full posts, scrubbed full posts, IDs needing re-collection, or derived data. Values: Full raw content / Anonymized or PII-scrubbed full content / Dehydrated IDs only / Aggregated statistics, embeddings or derived features only / Mixed (IDs plus derived features) / Not specified

field.name: access_mechanism
field.description: How a researcher obtains the files. Values: Open public download / Credentialed access, form or data use agreement / Email the authors for approval / Not specified

field.name: license_verbatim
field.description: License exactly as named in the paper, e.g. 'CC BY-NC 4.0'. '' if none.

field.name: license_category
field.description: License family of the dataset. Values: CC0 or public domain / CC BY / CC BY-SA / CC BY-NC (any NC variant) / Open Data Commons (ODbL, ODC-By, PDDL) / Software license (MIT, Apache, GPL, BSD) / Custom terms or data use agreement / Platform terms of service only / Not specified

field.name: data_file_formats
field.description: File formats of the release, uppercase, e.g. ['CSV','JSONL','PARQUET']. [] if not stated.

field.name: explicitly_mentions_fair
field.description: True if the paper names the FAIR principles.

field.name: documentation_framework
field.description: Standard documentation shipped with the data. Values: Datasheets for Datasets / Data Statements / Data Card or dataset card / Dataset Nutrition Label / Croissant or other machine-readable metadata / Custom README or codebook / None mentioned

field.name: provides_collection_or_hydration_code
field.description: True if code to collect, hydrate or load the data is released.

field.name: irb_status
field.description: Outcome of institutional ethics review as reported. Values: Approved by IRB or ethics board / Exempt or not human-subjects research (as determined by a board) / Self-assessed or checklist only / Not mentioned

field.name: pii_anonymization_applied
field.description: True if usernames, user IDs, mentions or other PII were removed, hashed or masked before release.

field.name: anonymization_details
field.description: Short description of privacy steps. '' if none.

field.name: discusses_platform_tos
field.description: True if compliance with platform terms of service is discussed.

field.name: discusses_limitations
field.description: True if the paper discusses biases or limitations of the dataset.

field.name: discusses_misuse_risks
field.description: True if potential misuse or harms of releasing the data are discussed.

field.name: includes_paper_checklist
field.description: True if the AAAI/ICWSM paper or ethics checklist appears in the text.

field.name: ai_usage_disclosed
field.description: True if the authors disclose using generative AI for writing or coding.

field.name: availability_quote
field.description: Verbatim sentence (max 50 words) stating where or how the dataset can be accessed. '' if none.

field.name: scale_quote
field.description: Verbatim sentence (max 50 words) stating dataset size or collection period. '' if none.

field.name: annotation_quote
field.description: Verbatim sentence (max 50 words) describing how labels were produced. '' if none.

field.name: ethics_quote
field.description: Verbatim sentence (max 50 words) on ethics review or privacy. '' if none.

field.name: license_quote
field.description: Verbatim sentence (max 50 words) naming the license. '' if none.

field.name: extraction_confidence
field.description: How clearly the paper reports its dataset metadata. Values: High / Medium / Low

field.name: ambiguity_notes
field.description: One or two sentences naming fields that were contradictory, vague or missing. '' if none.

field.name: quotes_grounded_share
field.description: Share of evidence quotes found (near-)verbatim in the paper text.

field.name: urls_grounded_share
field.description: Share of extracted dataset URLs that appear in the paper text.

field.name: n_flags
field.description: Number of automatic consistency flags (see 02_verify.py).

field.name: flags
field.description: Automatic consistency flags raised by 02_verify.py.

field.name: audit_manual_check
field.description: Date and note of a manual browser check that replaced the automatic link result.

field.name: audited_at
field.description: UTC time of the repository audit.

field.name: any_url_alive
field.description: True if at least one dataset link or the DOI resolved to live content.

field.name: primary_url_status
field.description: Outcome category for the first dataset link (Alive, Dead (404), Soft 404, Login wall, ...).

field.name: doi_resolves
field.description: True if https://doi.org/<doi> resolved to live content.

field.name: verified_repo
field.description: Repository whose API confirmed the record (Zenodo, Dataverse, Figshare, Hugging Face, GitHub, DataCite).

field.name: file_count
field.description: Number of files in the repository record (API).

field.name: total_size_mb
field.description: Total size of files in MB (API).

field.name: file_extensions
field.description: File extensions observed in the repository (API).

field.name: is_restricted
field.description: True if all files are restricted, embargoed or need manual approval.

field.name: files_empty
field.description: True if the repository record exists but contains no files.

field.name: login_wall
field.description: True if links only lead to a sign-in page.

field.name: account_required
field.description: True if a free account is needed (Kaggle, gated Hugging Face).

field.name: downloads_total
field.description: Total downloads reported by the repository (definitions differ across repositories).

field.name: downloads_unique
field.description: Unique downloads where reported (Zenodo, Dataverse).

field.name: views_total
field.description: Total views reported by the repository.

field.name: downloads_metric_source
field.description: Which counter downloads_total comes from. Compare downloads only within one source.

field.name: datacite_registered
field.description: True if the DOI is registered with DataCite.

field.name: datacite_citations
field.description: Citations to the dataset DOI recorded by DataCite.

field.name: code_url_alive
field.description: True if the code repository link resolves.

field.name: code_stars
field.description: GitHub stars of the code repository.

field.name: dead_link_in_wayback
field.description: For dead links: True if the Wayback Machine holds a snapshot of the landing page.

field.name: paper_doi
field.description: DOI of the ICWSM paper (OpenAlex).

field.name: citations
field.description: Citations to the ICWSM paper (OpenAlex).

field.name: years_since_publication
field.description: Years between June of the ICWSM year and the audit date.

field.name: citations_per_year
field.description: citations divided by years since publication.

field.name: downloads_per_year
field.description: downloads_total divided by years_since_publication.

field.name: fair_F1
field.description: FAIR indicator F1. Persistent identifier: A dataset DOI is reported and is registered with DataCite or resolves.

field.name: fair_F2
field.description: FAIR indicator F2. Rich metadata: A standard documentation framework (datasheet, data card, data statement, Croissant) is used.

field.name: fair_F4
field.description: FAIR indicator F4. Indexed: The dataset DOI is registered and findable in DataCite.

field.name: fair_A1
field.description: FAIR indicator A1. Retrievable: At least one dataset link resolves in the 2026 audit.

field.name: fair_A1_1
field.description: FAIR indicator A1.1. Open protocol: Files can be downloaded openly, without forms, approval or login walls.

field.name: fair_A2
field.description: FAIR indicator A2. Persistent hosting: Hosted on an archival repository (Zenodo, Dataverse, Figshare, OSF, ICPSR, GESIS...).

field.name: fair_I1
field.description: FAIR indicator I1. Open formats: Released in open, widely readable formats (CSV, JSON(L), Parquet, GraphML...).

field.name: fair_R1_1
field.description: FAIR indicator R1.1. Clear license: A license or explicit terms of use are stated.

field.name: fair_R1_2
field.description: FAIR indicator R1.2. Provenance: Collection method and temporal coverage (start and end) are reported.

field.name: fair_R1_3
field.description: FAIR indicator R1.3. Reusable pipeline: Code to collect, hydrate or load the data is released.

field.name: fair_score
field.description: Share (0-100) of the 10 operational FAIR indicators met.

field.name: fate_2026
field.description: Mutually exclusive 2026 state: Open and usable; Open, needs closed API to rehydrate; Restricted access (request or agreement); Alive but empty or login-walled; Link dead; Never released / no link.

field.name: needs_closed_api
field.description: True if content must be rehydrated through a platform API that is no longer free (Twitter/X).

field.name: funnel_release_claimed
field.description: Paper claims a release (now, partially, later or on request).

field.name: funnel_link_provided
field.description: Paper gives a dataset link or DOI.

field.name: funnel_link_alive
field.description: Link alive in the audit.

field.name: funnel_open_download
field.description: Files openly downloadable (not gated, empty or login-walled).

field.name: funnel_usable
field.description: Openly downloadable and usable without a closed API.

field.name: n_manual_overrides
field.description: Number of fields corrected by human curators.

field.name: body_mentions_misuse
field.description: Regex: misuse/harm language appears in the main text (before References), i.e. not only in the checklist.

field.name: body_mentions_fair
field.description: Regex: 'FAIR' (upper case) appears in the main text (before References), i.e. not only in the checklist.

field.name: body_mentions_datasheet
field.description: Regex: datasheet / data card / data statement named in the main text (before References).

field.name: repo_license
field.description: License recorded on the repository record itself (Zenodo, Dataverse, Figshare, Hugging Face, GitHub).

field.name: repo_license_present
field.description: True if the repository record carries a license (only for records the audit could verify).

field.name: model
field.description: LLM requested for extraction.

field.name: served_model
field.description: Model id the API reported serving for this record.

field.name: api_host
field.description: API host used for extraction (gateway or Anthropic API).

field.name: structured_mode
field.description: native (constrained decoding), prompt (schema in prompt + validation) or prompt-repair.

field.name: prompt_version
field.description: Extraction prompt version.

field.name: schema_version
field.description: Extraction schema version.

field.name: extracted_at
field.description: UTC time of extraction.
